verdict.rationale: dLocal documents Smart Fields for securely collecting card data inside the merchant's own checkout. It also lets merchants build their own payment form via the API with full control over look and feel, offered as an alternative to Checkout Redirect. However, the evidence says little about the Smart Fields components themselves: how they are customized, how they embed, and whether they cover payment methods beyond cards. Missing for 10: documented styling/customization options for Smart Fields, embedding details (JS SDK, iframes, mobile SDKs), coverage beyond cards, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed customizable payment components directly in my own site or app instead of redirecting to a hosted page

citations.quote: If your business is not Full PCI DSS compliant, you need to securely collect the card information using Smart Fields.
With dLocal API you can build your own payment form and take full control over the look and feel and experience of your checkout.
The important parameters are returned via API, so the merchant can build their own Pix UI.
